environment.source_note: Keel and runner sources are those of commit 8226e95c; the measuring checkout differed only in documentation, test-runner files and the date the assembly and link runner records.

protocol.ir_order: existing in-process harness rotates configurations each round; not randomized
protocol.c_boundary: subprocess wall time: raw C read, preprocessing, frontend (including Keel frontend-IR verification), configured optimization, native code generation, integrated assembly, object write; no linking
protocol.ir_boundary: sum of backend stage timers on identical parsed verified Keel IR; excludes parse/verify, IR optimization, process startup, filesystem writes, linking; CLIF verifier off during timing, on for gated objects; FNV64 verifier-on/off fingerprints checked per sample by existing harness
protocol.features: native objects include unwind services; Cranelift unwind_info=false; unequal services
protocol.scope: one maintained kernels translation unit; 21 named kernel checks plus helpers; no application or runtime performance claim
protocol.host_control: no enforced quiet-host gate, core pinning, frequency control or scheduling isolation; load snapshots only

suite_retired_instructions.method: cargo suite codegen-diff --baseline <keel> --candidate <keel> --target <host> --icount --expect-identical, with the same keel binary on both sides; each compile is counted once per side, so the two totals are two runs of the same compiler
